summary: PROGRAM-GOVERNANCE is bound to the implemented single-writer event log, per-task evidence gates and final zero-omission gate.
facts: Every task transition and finding disposition is represented by a validated append-only event.
Program completion requires all tasks, findings, requirement clauses and program evidence kinds.

acceptance.clause: 每个任务有证据包和问题处置，总纲零遗漏后才能关闭
acceptance.fact: The authority-bound control plane enforces per-task evidence, explicit finding disposition and a final all-requirement gate before completion.
